title: An independent reference sort and LCP check every small input across the build flags
body: Batch 1 of sufr-25f57e. A naive reference sort in the libsufr tests, comparing suffixes byte by byte under the seed mask, max_query_len, dropped N suffixes, softmask and the delimiter, plus a reference LCP by direct comparison of neighbours. Run over 1, 2, 3, abba, smol, mostlya1, mostlya2 and spaced_input in data/inputs under -a, -i, -D, masks 101 11011 1101 10111011, -m 1 3 5 and -n 1 2 3, and once with with_force_64bit. Assert the built suffix array and LCP equal the reference. Replaces the four vacuous *_is_sorted tests in sufr/tests/cli.rs. The open question on LCP above m (sufr-2b76b5) is on the parent.
